items.name: Critical rating per 1% chance
items.notes: Displayed crit % already includes rating. Extra rating / 219 = extra crit %.

items.name: Target resistance per 1% mitigation
items.notes: mitigation% = max(0, resist - pen) / 660, not R/(R+660). Caps at mitigation_cap.

items.name: PvE resistance mitigation cap
items.notes: 50% incoming damage reduction from resistance. 33000 resist at 660 per 1%.

items.name: Critical damage cap
items.notes: Total crit damage including the 50% base (1.5x). Bonus crit damage caps at +75%. docs/formulas.md is wrong where it says there is no cap.

items.name: Max resource per 1 Weapon or Spell Damage
items.notes: 1 Weapon/Spell Damage ≈ 10.5 of the matching max resource (U33+ hybrid).

items.name: Standard PvE dummy resistance
items.notes: Target resist for 6M / 21M dummy and most PvE ranking. Overpenetration above this is wasted.

items.name: Armor glyph value on small pieces
items.notes: Full glyph on head/chest/legs; 40% on shoulders/hands/waist/feet (e.g. Stamina 868 vs 347).

items.name: Set pieces from a two-handed weapon
items.notes: Bow, staff, and 2H count as 2 set pieces. Only the active-bar weapons count.
